identification.source: Wellmann (ed.) 1906, DMM III 75: "λιβανωτίς, ἣν Ῥωμαῖοι ῤουσμαρῖνον καλοῦσιν, ἧ καὶ οἱ στεφανοπλίκοι χρῶνται" (the libanotis the Romans call rosmarinus, used by garland-makers); Osbaldeston 2000, ch. 3-89: "Rosmarinus officinalis [Linnaeus]".
identification.note: Mostly naturalised from cultivation in Greece and only locally native (Dimopoulos et al. 2013); records may include planted or escaped plants.

alternatives.name: Cachrys libanotis / Seseli-type umbellifers (the other λιβανωτίδες of Wellmann III 74)

ema_monograph.name: Rosmarini folium (botanical name Rosmarinus officinalis L.)

caveats: Identification is probable; results describe Salvia rosmarinus Spenn., which may not be the plant Dioscorides meant.
